title: Stabilize a smooth section to a differential basis
statement: Let A and B be commutative rings, B a smooth A-algebra [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map], J an ideal of A, and σ:B→A/J an A-algebra map. There exist an A-algebra A₁ étale over A [def-weil-etale-morphism], an A-algebra D also equipped with a compatible A₁-algebra structure, with D smooth over A₁, and A-algebra maps j:B→D and τ:D→A/J such that τ∘j=σ and the composite A₁→D→A/J is surjective. Moreover there exist n≥0 and elements fᵢ∈D indexed by Fin n, all killed by τ, such that (1⊗dfᵢ) is a basis [def-weil-pbc-free-module] of (A/J)⊗_D Ω[D/A₁] [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials], where D acts on A/J through τ. No quotient or étale neighbourhood of D is asserted.

proof.text: Put N=ker σ. The map σ is surjective because σ(algebraMap(a)) is the class of a, and A→A/J is surjective. Apply the smooth conormal sequence. Its right term is (A/J)⊗_B Ω[B/A], finite projective by smoothness and base change of a finite projective module. The image of J/J² is (JB+N²)/N²: if σ(b) is the class of a and x∈J, then (b-algebraMap(a))algebraMap(x)∈N². Thus P=N/(N²+JB) identifies with that right term.

Choose a finite projective complement Kbar with P⊕Kbar≅(A/J)^n. By projective lifting, choose A→A₁ étale, a quotient equivalence α:A/J≅A₁/JA₁ compatible with A, and a finite projective A₁-module K whose reduction is Kbar base changed by α. Put B₁=A₁⊗_A B and σ₁(a₁⊗b)=class(a₁)α(σ(b)). Base change of smoothness and differentials gives P₁≅P⊗_(A/J)(A₁/JA₁), so P₁⊕K/JK is free of rank n.

Construct D=B₁⊗_(A₁) Sym_(A₁)(K). The symmetric algebra is smooth, so D is smooth over A₁. Its augmentation p:D→B₁ and σ₁ give the section ρ:D→A₁/JA₁. Writing the augmentation ideal as k, its degree-one quotient k/k² is B₁⊗K, and ker ρ=j(ker σ₁)⊕k. Modulo the square of ker ρ and JD, the degree-zero part is P₁ and the degree-one part is K/JK. Products of positive-degree elements and products with the old kernel are killed. Thus the conormal module along ρ is P₁⊕K/JK, finite free of rank n.

Choose a basis of the free conormal module and lift each vector to an fᵢ∈ker ρ. The conormal identification sends these vectors to 1⊗dfᵢ. Compose ρ with α⁻¹ to obtain τ:D→A/J; restrict the canonical map into D to B to obtain j. The maps are A-linear and τj=σ. The composite A₁→D→A/J is the quotient A₁→A₁/JA₁ followed by α⁻¹, hence surjective. Transport the basis along α⁻¹.

A smooth section to A modulo an ideal has a free differential module after etale base change and tensoring a symmetric algebra of a finite projective complement

lean.statement:
theorem exists_smooth_section_differential_basis
    (A B : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    [Algebra.Smooth A B] (J : Ideal A) (σ : B →ₐ[A] A ⧸ J) :
    ∃ A₁ : CommAlgCat.{u} A,
      Etale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A A₁))) ∧
      ∃ (D : CommAlgCat.{u} A) (_ : Algebra A₁ D) (_ : IsScalarTower A A₁ D),
        Algebra.Smooth A₁ D ∧
        ∃ (j : B →ₐ[A] D) (τ : D →ₐ[A] A ⧸ J),
          τ.comp j = σ ∧
          Function.Surjective (τ.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap A₁ D)) ∧
          ∃ (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → D), (∀ i, τ (f i) = 0) ∧
            letI : Algebra D (A ⧸ J) := τ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
            ∃ b : Module.Basis (Fin n) (A ⧸ J) ((A ⧸ J) ⊗[D] KaehlerDifferential A₁ D),
              ∀ i, b i = 1 ⊗ₜ[D] KaehlerDifferential.D A₁ D (f i)
